messages:
sarah-support: Hey team -- customer `acmetoys` opened a high-priority ticket: their similarity search started returning empty results this morning after we rolled a pinned model. They're seeing an error in their indexer: `embedding length mismatch: expected 1536, got 2048`.

sarah-support: Customer says they pinned `embed-large:v1` in their app but we rolled the model id to `embed-large:v2` behind the scenes for eligible customers. They claim they were explicitly pinned and shouldn't have been moved. Ticket attached: https://support.example/INC-4231 

ops-bot: deploy-bot noticed: `deploy completed: model/embed-large:v2 @ 1719950012` and rollout policy `pin-compat=soft` (this allowed pinned group fallback)

maggie-cs: Pinged customer to ask for request/response sample. They sent back a minimal curl they used to index one doc: 
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx' \
  -d '{"model":"embed-large","input":"hello world"}'
```
Response (truncated):
```
{"data":[{"embedding":[0.00012, ... , 0.392]}],"embedding_length":2048}
```
Customer indexer expects length 1536 and fails with assertion.

leo-eng: Repro'd locally using their API key + pin header. When I force `Pinned-Model: embed-large:v1` header we still get v2 tokens, looks like the pin granularity isn't honored in the rollback path. I suspect the model metadata changed (new projection head -> 2048 dims) and our pin-resolution service returned the newer variant for that customer due to a race in the pin metadata cache.

jia-ml: Quick explanation: embed-large:v2 uses a different final linear projection (we expanded the projection to 2048 to better capture semantics). That absolutely changes embedding vector size. Pins should prevent that but if the pin points to a symbolic alias (eg `embed-large`) instead of immutable model-hash then a later alias update will flip the dims. We have a mismatch between alias/pin semantics.

sarah-support: Customer wants immediate remediation: they can't search for production users. Options? rollback, reindex (painful), or shim (pad/truncate) on the app side.

leo-eng: Short-term mitigation we can offer: 1) Roll back alias -> point `embed-large` alias to the previous model commit for the pinned customers only. 2) Provide a compatibility shim in the proxy that will automatically pad/truncate embeddings to the pinned customer's expected dim for reads/writes. I can push a temporary gate in the routing layer.

maggie-cs: Customer prefers we do the fix server-side, they don't have time to reindex. Can we guarantee no accuracy loss if we truncate/pad? They rely heavily on nearest-neighbor ranking.

jia-ml: Padding/truncation is lossy. Truncation will drop trailing components; padding with zeros is less damaging but still not equivalent. Best is rollback + re-run evaluation before reintroducing v2. But rollback must be targeted.

ops-bot: incident-bot: `pin-cache invalidation event @ 1719950500`

leo-eng: Root cause: rollout pipeline merged an alias update and a pin-metadata cache push in the same maintenance window. Some pin entries were stored as alias pointers instead of pinned hashes. When alias updated, pinned customers got redirected. Also found a bug in continuous-batching: when multiple requests in a batch route to different model hashes we used the output of the first model for shape assumptions, leading to silent shape coalescing and then an assert at the indexer. That explains intermittent failures during high-throughput ingestion.

sarah-support: Action plan proposed: 
- Immediate: rollback alias for `embed-large` to v1 for affected tenant IDs (acmetoys and two others) (leo to run)
- Hotfix: deploy routing guard that rejects batched requests mixing model hashes; return 409 with clear message if mixed shapes detected (leo + eng infra)
- Short term: offer proxy shim for customers who can't reindex (provide padding with clear caveats) (leo + jia)
- Long term: enforce embedding-dim check in model onboarding and add a pre-rollout validation step that rejects alias updates if dims change for any alias that has pinned customers (product + release)

deploy-bot: `rolling back alias embed-large -> embed-large@rev-5 (v1) for tenants: acmetoys, shopgreen @ 1719951200`

customer-ops: Confirmed with acmetoys: after rollback their nightly batch re-ran and indexer accepted 1536-length vectors again. They reported partial recovery. Still need to reindex docs that were ingested with 2048 dims earlier.

maggie-cs: I've scheduled a reindex offer with customer (we'll bulk re-embed those few hundred thousand docs using v1) and offered credits for the work. They accepted.

jia-ml: Example shim we can give customers (python) — pads/truncates to expected length: 
```python
def compat_vector(v, expected_len=1536):
    if len(v) > expected_len:
        return v[:expected_len]
    if len(v) < expected_len:
        return v + [0.0] * (expected_len - len(v))
    return v
```
Note: use as last-resort only. Recommend reindex.

leo-eng: I'll also add a server-side compat flag `X-Embed-Compat: pad-to=1536` that will apply the same logic in the routing proxy for pinned-tenants. Will ship as a hotfix behind feature flag.

sarah-support: Postmortem notes to add: check pin semantics, make alias->hash mapping immutable for pinned tenants, add automated pre-rollout embedding-dim diff check, and fix batch coalescing codepath.

maggie-cs: Customer asked for timeline. We committed: rollback done (immediate), shim proxy shipping in ~3 hours behind flag, reindex script and credit processing in 24h.

leo-eng: Filed internal bug: `ENG-14562 pin-alias-race-and-batch-shape` with repro and logs. Repro steps included in the ticket: 
1) Create alias `embed-large` pointing to rev-5 (1536 dims).
2) Pin tenant to alias (incorrectly stored as alias pointer).
3) Update alias to rev-8 (2048 dims) and push cache simultaneously.
4) Send batched index requests from tenant -> mismatch observed.

sarah-support: Closing loop with customer, marking as `mitigated` and moving ticket to postmortem. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

maggie-cs: Follow-up: product wants a dashboard metric for "embedding-dim-changes-per-alias" so we can gate rollouts. assigning to product/metrics.

leo-eng: I'll put a short-runbook for support: how to detect dim-mismatch, commands to rollback alias, and the shim snippet. We'll attach to the ticket.

customer-ops: Thanks team. acmetoys happy for now, will validate full search accuracy after reindex.

sarah-support: End.
